name: opencode-omniroute-auth
description: OpenCode V1/V2 authentication plugin for OmniRoute API with /connect command and dynamic model fetching

scripts.check:exports: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((m)=>{const d=m.default;if(typeof d!=='object'||d===null){throw new Error('Default export must be an object with id/setup (V2) and server (V1)');}if(typeof d.id!=='string'||d.id.length===0){throw new Error('Default export id must be a non-empty string');}if(typeof d.setup!=='function'){throw new Error('Default export must expose setup() for OpenCode V2');}if(typeof d.server!=='function'){throw new Error('Default export must expose server() for OpenCode V1');}for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(m)){if(key==='default')continue;if(typeof value!=='function'&&typeof value!=='object'){throw new Error('Root export '+key+' must be a function or object');}}})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check:exports
